left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Age between 45-75 years
  -  Have overweight  [OR] or obesity condition based in BMI (Body Mass Index)

right.raw_text: Individuals with BMI of 25 or more

left.raw_text: -  Have two of these three risk: sedentary lifestyle, [OR]  poor diet  [OR] and binge episodes
-  Ability to understand oral and written Spanish

right.raw_text: -  Willingness to participate in the study and signing informed consent

left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Any diagnosis of a disease that may affect the central nervous system (brain condition, [OR]  traumatic brain injury, [OR]  dementia, etc)

right.raw_text: -  Other psychiatric diagnoses  [OR] or acute psychiatric illness (substance dependence  [OR] or abuse, history of schizophrenia or other psychotic disorders, etc

left.raw_text: ), except for anxiety disorder  [OR] or personality disorders
-  Presence of delusional ideas  [OR] or hallucinations whether consistent or not with mood
